name: brisketbox-monorepo
description: BrisketBox - Freshness, Sealed with Flavour Full-Stack D2C Fresh Meat & Coastal Seafood Platform with Reusable Cold-Box Logistics

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.build: cd frontend && npm install && npm run build
scripts.test:frontend: npm --prefix frontend run lint && npm --prefix frontend run build && node scripts/check-bundle-size.js && npx playwright test && npx lhci autorun
scripts.audit: npm --prefix backend audit --audit-level=high && npm --prefix frontend audit --audit-level=high
scripts.check: node scripts/check-backend-syntax.js && node scripts/lint-colors.js && npm run audit && npm run test:frontend && npm run test:backend
